objective: Package an offline-capable incident-response plugin for regulated teams.

artifactRecommendation.rationale: The capability combines a Skill, agent, and guarded hooks.

inputs.name: incident manifest
inputs.description: Approved incident identifiers and source paths

effects.description: Writes the summary inside the selected workspace.
effects.mitigation: Resolve and verify every output path beneath the workspace root.
Use an allowlist and record command results.

assumptions: The host provides a writable isolated workspace
risks: Diagnostic output can contain sensitive data

productionBoundary.statement: Use only in an isolated incident workspace with human approval before external publication.
